# goslop text fixture — attr/cache probe with constant fallback (logxide
# fast_logger_wrapper FP shape)
lang: python
file: fast_logger_wrapper.py
---
WARNING = 30

class FastLogger:
    def _update_cache(self):
        try:
            self._effective_level = self._rust_logger.getEffectiveLevel()
            self._name = self._rust_logger.name
        except Exception:
            self._effective_level = WARNING
            self._name = "root"
